core_step: Analyze user requirements and constraints (dates, origin, cities, budget, cuisine, no flights).
why_essential: Establishes the trip parameters that determine data queries, route, and itinerary constraints.
evidence: "I'll start by analyzing the user's requirements... Trip duration: 7 days (March 17-23, 2022) - N... Budget is up to $5,100... prefer not to take any flights"

why_essential: Starts the specialized planning workflow required by the agent to orchestrate dataset searches and itinerary generation.
Provides access to the local datasets (cities, distances, attractions, restaurants, accommodations) required to build a data-driven itinerary.

core_step: Query available Ohio cities from the city dataset.
why_essential: Identifies candidate Ohio cities to include in the 3-city route component of the itinerary.

core_step: Query driving distances and durations between Minneapolis and candidate Ohio cities and between Ohio cities.
why_essential: Provides travel time, distances, and drive costs needed to ensure a feasible self-driving route and to compute budget/travel logistics.
evidence: "GoogleDistanceMatrix loaded.\nMinneapolis to Cleveland: driving, ... duration: 11 hours 14 mins, distance: 1,219 km, cost: 60"

core_step: Load attractions data for selected Ohio cities.
why_essential: Supplies the points of interest to populate daily attraction entries in the itinerary.
evidence:
"Attractions loaded.
=== Cleveland ===
 Name ... Cleveland Metroparks Zoo ... Cleveland
1 The Cleveland Museum of Art ... Cleveland"

core_step: Load restaurants and accommodations data (including cuisines and prices) for Minneapolis and selected Ohio cities.
why_essential: Provides venue options to satisfy cuisine preferences (BBQ, Seafood, Chinese, Mexican) and accommodation choices to fill daily meals and lodging within the budget.
evidence:
"Restaurants loaded.
Columns: ['Name', 'Average Cost', 'Cuisines', 'Aggregate Rating', 'City']" and "Accommodations loaded.
=== Cleveland ===
 NAME price ..."

core_step: Write the finalized 7-day itinerary JSON to /app/output/itinerary.json.
why_essential: Produces the required output file in the specified location and format for the user.
